cover.title: 5 niche ways to get funded by europe without giving up equity

inner.title: take the grant only
inner.body: the eic accelerator offers grant-only funding below €2.5m, with no equity taken. you get that option once in all of horizon europe, so don't waste it.

inner.title: pitch any month
inner.body: send the eic step 1 short proposal any month. four experts judge you from a 3-minute video, not your business plan.

inner.title: cash the seal
inner.body: score 13/15 without a win and the eic gives you a seal of excellence. spain's cdti offered seal holders in two regions up to €2.5m in may 2026.

inner.title: find a partner abroad
inner.body: eurostars funds sme-led r&d with partners from at least two countries. each national funder pays its own team, and the next deadline is march 2027.

inner.title: check if you're widening
inner.body: the eic pre-accelerator gave up to €500k to 70 deep-tech startups, mostly in widening countries. your address decides if you qualify.

closer.HEADLINE:
europe will fund you.
it just won't own you.
closer.SUBLINE: if you read the rules before the deadline.
